verdict: A quiet day: mostly unreleased research papers and routine VFX breakdowns, nothing that lands as a usable tool or changes pipeline decisions this week.

stories.headline: Apple Studios VFX crew ratifies first IATSE contract
stories.body: Apple Studios' in-house VFX crew has ratified its first contract under IATSE, establishing union terms for visual effects work at Apple's production arm. This is a labor and rights development, not a technical one, but it sets precedent for how VFX work is organized at a major streamer-studio and affects staffing terms on future Apple productions.
stories.why: Changes bargaining terms and working conditions for VFX staff at a major studio.

stories.headline: SoulX-FlashHead image-to-video model updated on Hugging Face
stories.body: Soul-AILab's SoulX-FlashHead-1_3B, a Wan-based image-to-video diffusion model, received an update on Hugging Face. It uses a non-standard ('other') licence, runs via diffusers/safetensors, and has modest community traction (63 likes, ~3,300 downloads). No release notes or benchmark details were provided, so capability claims are unverified.
stories.why: Worth a glance only if the licence terms permit client work; unverified beyond the model card.
